title: Does Your Computer Keep Freezing Too?
title_hi: क्या आपका कंप्यूटर बहुत धीमा रहता है?
content:
Is your computer freezing too?

If you are in search of an answer to “Why does my computer keep freezing” then simply sit back and relax; as your problem is fixable. It is not a serious issue. Most often freezing of your computer system indicates that something is going wrong inside, and it demands fixing before it turns out into a big problem. Although freezing is a very common phenomenon which must have been experienced by most of the computer users, it shouldn’t be overlooked. The sooner you sort out the issue, the better it will prove for your system. So from next time whenever your computer system freezes, need not to panic as you know it can be easily resolved.
content_hi:
क्या आपका कंप्यूटर भी धीमा है?

यदि आप उत्तर की तलाश में हैं & ldquo; मेरा कंप्यूटर ठंडा क्यों रहता है & rdquo; तो बस वापस बैठो और आराम करो; क्योंकि आपकी समस्या ठीक हो सकती है। यह एक गंभीर मुद्दा नहीं है। अक्सर आपके कंप्यूटर सिस्टम को ठंडा करने से संकेत मिलता है कि अंदर कुछ गलत हो रहा है, और यह बड़ी समस्या में आने से पहले फिक्सिंग की मांग करता है। हालांकि ठंड एक बहुत आम घटना है जिसे अधिकांश कंप्यूटर उपयोगकर्ताओं द्वारा अनुभव किया जाना चाहिए, इसे अनदेखा नहीं किया जाना चाहिए। जितनी जल्दी आप इस मुद्दे को हल करेंगे, बेहतर होगा यह आपके सिस्टम के लिए साबित होगा। तो अगली बार जब भी आपका कंप्यूटर सिस्टम फ्रीज हो, आपको घबराहट न करने की आवश्यकता है क्योंकि आपको पता है कि इसे आसानी से हल किया जा सकता है।

ai_summary: Computer freezing is a common issue that can often be fixed without panic, indicating underlying problems that need attention.
Possible causes of freezing include virus infections, incompatible software, or issues with the computer's registry.
Using a registry cleaner can help resolve freezing problems, but caution is advised when manually repairing the registry.

sub_contents.sub_title: Am I responsible for making my computer freeze?
sub_contents.sub_title_hi: क्या मैं अपने कंप्यूटर को स्थिर करने के लिए जिम्मेदार हूं?
sub_contents.sub_content:
Whenever a computer freezes most people think that they are responsible for it, and it is because that they have attempted something wrong or unusual. Although it can be considered as a normal reaction, but most likely it is not the exclusive cause.

If we try to relate it with your activities then it might be because of the reason that any infected mail was opened by you, or you might have accidently downloaded a virus from the internet that has tainted your computer system. Whatever may be the reason, all you need to know is that your computer’s performance is affected and you should fix it up.

Why did my Computer Freeze?

You may come across a numerous reasons in your quest for an answer to “why does my computer keep freezing”. The most preliminary one may be that your computer is infected with some virus or may be something of similar nature. There is also a possibility that it might be because of some newly installed software program which is not very much compatible with your computer system, and hence your system is freezing.

Despite of these possibilities, one can be sure that the sole cause behind this lies in the registry of the computer system. Actually, the registry of computer acts like an intellect and if something is wrong with it, it interrupts the normal performance of computer.

Can I fix my computer?

Yes freezing problems can be fixed in most cases. As the most probable region of the problem is registry, one must focus over that. But make sure you do not start experimenting with the content of registry as it might cause a bigger problem. One should not try manually repairing the registry until he has good knowledge of it.

Some easy steps to stop your computer from freezing

After observing the all the reasons of your question “why does my computer keep freezing”, you should move ahead to a simple step of using a registry cleaner and allow it to settle your registry problems. Although program won’t do anything on its own, you need to guide its working. However, it’s an easy process and anyone can do that.

These small software programs are readily available over the internet at a low cost. You may also use online registry resolver software which does not require program to be downloaded over your system.
sub_contents.sub_content_hi:
जब भी कोई कंप्यूटर फ्रीज करता है तो ज्यादातर लोग सोचते हैं कि वे इसके लिए ज़िम्मेदार हैं, और ऐसा इसलिए है क्योंकि उन्होंने कुछ गलत या असामान्य प्रयास किया है। हालांकि इसे सामान्य प्रतिक्रिया के रूप में माना जा सकता है, लेकिन अधिकतर यह एकमात्र कारण नहीं है।

अगर हम इसे अपनी गतिविधियों से जोड़ना चाहते हैं तो हो सकता है कि किसी भी संक्रमित मेल को आपके द्वारा खोला गया हो, या आपने इंटरनेट से वायरस को गलती से डाउनलोड किया हो जिसने आपके कंप्यूटर सिस्टम को दंडित किया हो। जो कुछ भी कारण हो, आपको यह जानने की जरूरत है कि आपके कंप्यूटर का प्रदर्शन प्रभावित होता है और आपको इसे ठीक करना चाहिए।

मेरा कंप्यूटर फ्रीज क्यों किया गया?

आप अपने खोज में कई कारणों से आ सकते हैं & ldquo; मेरा कंप्यूटर ठंडा क्यों रहता है & rdquo ;. सबसे प्रारंभिक यह हो सकता है कि आपका कंप्यूटर कुछ वायरस से संक्रमित हो या ऐसा कुछ प्रकृति हो। यह भी संभावना है कि यह कुछ नए स्थापित सॉफ्टवेयर प्रोग्राम की वजह से हो सकता है जो आपके कंप्यूटर सिस्टम के साथ बहुत संगत नहीं है, और इसलिए आपका सिस्टम ठंडा हो रहा है।

इन संभावनाओं के बावजूद, कोई यह सुनिश्चित कर सकता है कि इसके पीछे एकमात्र कारण कंप्यूटर सिस्टम की रजिस्ट्री में निहित है। असल में, कंप्यूटर की रजिस्ट्री एक बुद्धि की तरह काम करती है और यदि इसमें कुछ गड़बड़ है, तो यह कंप्यूटर के सामान्य प्रदर्शन में बाधा डालता है।

क्या मैं अपना कंप्यूटर ठीक कर सकता हूं?

ज्यादातर मामलों में हां ठंड समस्याएं ठीक की जा सकती हैं। चूंकि समस्या का सबसे संभावित क्षेत्र रजिस्ट्री है, इसलिए उस पर ध्यान देना चाहिए। लेकिन सुनिश्चित करें कि आप रजिस्ट्री की सामग्री के साथ प्रयोग शुरू नहीं करते हैं क्योंकि इससे बड़ी समस्या हो सकती है। किसी को रजिस्ट्री को मैन्युअल रूप से सुधारने की कोशिश नहीं करनी चाहिए जब तक कि उसके पास इसका अच्छा ज्ञान न हो।

अपने कंप्यूटर को ठंड से रोकने के लिए कुछ आसान कदम

अपने प्रश्न के सभी कारणों को देखने के बाद & ldquo; मेरा कंप्यूटर ठंड क्यों रखता है & rdquo ;, आपको रजिस्ट्री क्लीनर का उपयोग करने के एक सरल चरण में आगे बढ़ना चाहिए और इसे अपनी रजिस्ट्री समस्याओं को सुलझाने की अनुमति देना चाहिए। यद्यपि प्रोग्राम अपने आप कुछ भी नहीं करता है, आपको इसके कामकाज की मार्गदर्शिका करने की आवश्यकता है। हालांकि, यह एक आसान प्रक्रिया है और कोई भी ऐसा कर सकता है।

ये छोटे सॉफ्टवेयर प्रोग्राम कम लागत पर इंटरनेट पर आसानी से उपलब्ध हैं। आप ऑनलाइन रजिस्ट्री रिज़ॉल्वर सॉफ़्टवेयर का भी उपयोग कर सकते हैं जिसके लिए प्रोग्राम को आपके सिस्टम पर डाउनलोड करने की आवश्यकता नहीं है।

related.title: Impact of Rising Fuel Prices on Indian Economy
related.title_hi: भारत की अर्थव्यवस्था पर बढ़ती ईंधन की कीमतों का प्रभाव
related.content:
Rising fuel prices have a significant impact on the Indian economy, affecting various sectors and the daily lives of citizens. As fuel prices increase, transportation costs rise, leading to higher prices for goods and services. This situation creates a ripple effect, influencing inflation rates and overall economic stability.

Moreover, higher fuel costs strain the budgets of both individuals and businesses, leading to decreased consumer spending and investment. Understanding these dynamics is crucial for grasping the broader economic implications of fuel price fluctuations in India.

related.title: Impact of Electric Vehicles on India's Economy
related.title_hi: भारत की अर्थव्यवस्था पर इलेक्ट्रिक वाहनों का प्रभाव
related.content:
Electric vehicles (EVs) are rapidly transforming the transportation landscape in India, presenting both challenges and opportunities for the economy. As the country strives to reduce its dependence on fossil fuels and combat pollution, the adoption of electric vehicles is becoming a pivotal part of its economic strategy. This shift not only promises to create a greener environment but also offers significant economic benefits, from job creation to advancements in technology.

The shift towards electric mobility is expected to enhance India's energy security, create new markets, and foster innovation in various sectors. By investing in EV infrastructure and technologies, India aims to position itself as a global leader in the electric vehicle industry, contributing positively to the overall economic growth.

related.title: What is an annular solar eclipse?
related.content:
As the name suggests it is a solar eclipse. There are three major types of solar eclipses.

The total solar eclipse, partial solar eclipse, and the annular solar eclipse.  

The name “annular” has its origin from the Latin word “annulus”, "a ring". If the characteristic ring of fire is visible from even just one location, the whole eclipse is called an annular solar eclipse.

However, in most places and for most of the duration, an annular eclipse looks like a partial solar eclipse. At Box of Science, we are trying to reach out to people so that they may understand and observe this celestial event, as such events are very rare.

related.title: Fact Check: Is World Going To End On June 21 According To Mayan Calendar?
related.title_hi: तथ्य की जाँच करें: क्या मई 21 कैलेंडर के अनुसार विश्व का अंत हो सकता है?
related.content:
Fact check: A number of social media users have shared a conspiracy theory suggesting that the world will end on June 21, 2020, but they have proven false.

 

What does the theory suggest? 

According to various conspiracy theorists on social media, the initial reading of the Mayan calendar which suggested that the world will end in 2012 was wrong. It originally prophesied by calendar readers that the world will end on December 21, 2012, according to the Mayan calendar. The new theory suggests that we are 'technically' still in the year 2012 if the Julian calendar is followed. The theory also bases its claims on a previously falsified theory which suggested that eight years were lost during the transition from the Julian to the Gregorian calendar. 

 

Origin

Social media has witnessed a recent trend where a number of conspiracy theorists have been posting unverified theories on the internet which increase the paranoia in people's minds. As the COVID-19 outbreak became a global scare, a number of users started posting theories that suggest that 2020 will be the final year witnessed by humanity. Some wild theories also suggested that the events of the apocalypse are taking place in the world, but did not have any concrete evidence backing them. Similarly, the recent conspiracy theory doing the rounds on social media which suggests that the world will end on June 21, 2020, according to the Mayan calendar also does not hold any truth. 

 

The world was previously prophesied to end on December 21, 2012. Various conspiracy theorists used the Mayan calendar to push a theory that put a doomsday on Earth's experience. This latest conspiracy theory also uses the Mayan calendar theory which was officially shunned by NASA back in 2012. NASA officials had stated during a public conversation there was no science behind any claims of disaster and dramatic changes in 2012, also that there was no evidence that could back the theory. Since there was no evidence, NASA deemed the theory as a fictional assertion that could not change the facts.
